epic.title: Parent Academic Oversight Module
epic.body: Provides parents with a comprehensive view of their children's academic progress, including homework tracking, study material access, and subject-wise curriculum oversight for multiple children.

features.title: Homework & Assignment Monitoring
features.body: Interface for parents to track pending and completed homework assignments for their children, including due dates and specific teacher instructions.

stories.title: Student Homework List Interface
stories.body: Display a chronological list of homework assignments for the selected child, categorized by completion status and subject.
acceptanceCriteria: List: Show homework cards with Subject, Title, Description, and Due Date.
Status: Display badges for 'Pending' and 'Completed' status.
Filtering: Support filtering homework by subject (e.g., Math, Science) and date range.
Multi-Child Context: Automatically update the list when switching between child profiles in the dashboard.

stories.title: Homework Data Service
stories.body: API endpoints to retrieve homework assignments scoped to the specific students linked to the authenticated parent.
acceptanceCriteria: List: GET endpoint to fetch all homework for a specific studentId.
Security: Validate that the requesting parent is authorized to access the student's academic records.
Filtering: Support server-side filtering by status and subject.

features.title: Study Material & Resource Access
features.body: Provides parents and students access to digital learning materials shared by teachers, including PDFs, PPTs, and external educational links.

stories.title: Study Material Repository Interface
stories.body: Display a categorized repository of learning resources for the child's enrolled subjects.
acceptanceCriteria: Categorization: Group materials by type (PDF, PPT, Links) and Subject.
Visuals: Use subject-specific color coding for cards to match the student's timetable.
Download/View: Enable clicking on materials to open links or download files.
Metadata: Display file sizes and upload dates as provided in the student view.

stories.title: Academic Material Provider API
stories.body: API to serve study material metadata and file links for students within a parent's scope.
acceptanceCriteria: List: GET endpoint to fetch all study materials for a specific studentId.
Categorization: Ensure responses include material types and subject mappings for proper UI grouping.
Read: Provide secure links for resource access.

features.title: Dashboard Academic Overview
features.body: High-level summary of academic workload and task completion directly on the parent dashboard.

stories.title: Dashboard Homework Counters
stories.body: Real-time indicators on the dashboard showing the number of pending tasks for the selected child.
acceptanceCriteria: Display: Show a 'Pending Homework' count card on the parent dashboard.
Navigation: Clicking the card navigates directly to the Academics/Homework tab for that child.

stories.title: Academic Summary Aggregator
stories.body: Backend service to calculate counts of pending academic tasks.
acceptanceCriteria: Aggregate: GET endpoint to return counts of pending homework for a childId.
